ar.body: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ ﴿٢٩﴾
ar.source: Tanzil Project, https://tanzil.net, CC BY 3.0; English: Saheeh International

en.body: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
en.source: Tanzil Project, https://tanzil.net, CC BY 3.0; English: Saheeh International

ar.title: حان وقت التوقّف
ar.body: خذ لحظةً للتفكر، ثم اعمل بشيء مما تعلّمته؛ بصلاة، أو مساعدة أحد، أو نشر فائدة.

en.title: Time for a pause
en.body: Take a moment to reflect, then put something you learned into practice — pray, help someone, or share a benefit.
